author: ZimaOS Team
description: 2FAuth is a web based self-hosted alternative to One Time Passcode (OTP) generators like Google Authenticator, designed for both mobile and desktop.
tagline: A web app to manage your Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) accounts and generate their security codes
title: 2FAuth
release_note:
- v8.0.2 fixes OpenID API tokens, extension URLs requiring a trailing slash, and errors when sharing without email configured.
- Upgrading to v8 invalidates existing personal access tokens; reverse-proxy authentication also requires TRUSTED_PROXIES.
